parsed.note_claim: Independent news reporting shows no evidence of fighter-jet-escorted Air India evacuations in the current Gulf crisis.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Major airlines like Air India and IndiGo have suspended flights to the region . Carriers are monitoring advisories and Notice to Air Missions (NOTAMs) for re-routing.
parsed.reason: The article states Air India has suspended flights and no evacuation plans are announced, substantiating the note's claim that there is no evidence of such evacuations.
